description: List users in the company (id, name, email, type, hourly rate, assigned/managed projects). Paymo: GET /api/users.

active.description: true = active users only, false = retired users only.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 100, max 500). Paymo has no pagination; results beyond this are truncated.

where.description: Extra raw Paymo filter ANDed onto the typed ones, e.g. `billable=true` or `name like Website`. Operators: = > >= < <= != like, not like, in (a,b), not in (a,b).

name: paymo_list_users
title: List users
